title: Modern Shiso-Wrapped Sashimi & Ponzu Spoon
ingredients: This is a beautiful, modern sashimi bite served in a small dipping bowl or a porcelain spoon. Wrapping the fish tightly around a hidden pocket of rice flattens the leaf entirely.
The Setup: 1 slapped shiso leaf per bite \+ 1 thin slice of Sashimi-grade Tuna or Salmon \+ a small "pill" of sushi rice (the size of a marble).
The Sauce: A splash of Ponzu sauce (citrus soy sauce) and a drop of pure toasted sesame oil.
The Topping: A tiny pinch of toasted sesame seeds or finely grated fresh ginger.
instructions: Place your slapped shiso leaf flat on a clean surface.
Put a tiny marble-sized ball of seasoned sushi rice in the middle.
Wrap the shiso leaf tightly around the rice ball.
Take your slice of fish and wrap it around the outside of the shiso leaf, completely blanketing the herb.
Set this little bundle into a small bowl or a deep appetizer spoon.
Pour a tiny splash of ponzu sauce and sesame oil directly over the top and garnish with sesame seeds. Eat it in one savory, citrusy bite.
Would you prefer to try the Shiso "Taco" using a richer fish like salmon, or the Shiso-Wrapped Spoon using a cleaner, lighter fish like tuna?
